title: Service and tooling assertion-to-journey candidate ledger
scope: All frozen tests and assertion_sites except catalyst-xctest and swift-package-tests. Includes tooling prerequisites, not extra UI journeys.

evidence_policy.source_review: All75 baseline files were loaded via git show and SHA256 verified. All458 tests now have explicit source-derived behavioral or implementation/system dispositions; exact1945 source predicates and contexts retained. This does NOT certify assertion-level semantic equivalence or execution.
evidence_policy.association_limit: TypeScript AST callback spans, Python AST enclosing tests, and balanced named native function bodies identify lexical owners. Whole-script entries identify inventory containment only. Parameterized bodies retain multiple exact IDs; direct/transitive helper calls are static relationships, not proof of branch execution; two FakeS3 property-dispatch predicates retain possible fixture consumers only. Original candidate_test_ids remain nonauthoritative historical pointers.
evidence_policy.counting: One record per frozen assertion source line, not one runtime assertion. Multiple predicates on a line and dynamic loop/subTest expansions remain in exact source; no runtime execution count inferred.
evidence_policy.mapping_meaning: Every key is routed to proposed journey checkpoint(s) and an explicit gap. Key completeness is not completed behavioral equivalence or coverage.
evidence_policy.permissions: No production edits, legacy deletion, native launches, external operations, signing, pairing, payment, service writes or publication performed by this map.
evidence_policy.semantic_status: 406 concrete proposed contracts have unverified actual-app/system routes and oracles;52 implementation/model/fixture/harness/system requirements remain distinct. Zero family-only test destinations remain. All458 tests and1945 source predicates remain unverified for replacement equivalence.

reconciliation.assertion_exact_ownership_unresolved_mea: 68 sites have no SINGLE test_id:26 shared parameterized bodies and40 static helper sites have explicit many-to-many relationships;2 dynamic FakeS3 helper sites have only possible fixture consumers. No sites are dropped.

required_followup: All458 test contracts and1945 exact source predicates still need independent actual-app/system equivalence evidence; no retirement permitted.

26 parameterized assertion lines have multiple exact lexical owners;40 helper lines have static caller relationships;2 dynamic FakeS3 helper lines retain possible consumers only. Expand loop/subTest/runtime variants without treating source-line counts as executed assertions.
Implementation-only/test-registration/model/harness requirements need system prerequisites or explicit obsolescence decisions. Legacy AppKit runtime verifier is not Catalyst actual-app acceptance.
Record scenario/case/checkpoint,actual control route,app/source hash,run identity,independent saved/protocol/byte/visual witnesses and cleanup before granting coverage.

identity.step: Request/verify/resend; resume account; revoke the other device
identity.boundary: Native account flow plus authenticated HTTP and durable identity storage

single-use PKCE and wrong verifier

identity.unresolved_gap: Local worker with controlled mail/seeded identities is not native sign-in or real email delivery. Crypto/storage and race assertions need controlled service observations, not a successful login screenshot.

atomic.step: Edit structure; interrupt multipart commit; resume receipt; restore history
atomic.boundary: Real project command endpoint, transaction, replay and two clients
invariant_matrix: 1001-item resize and 202-item delete

atomic.required_observation: Compare complete before/after snapshots, history and lease sets; peer must never observe partial edits; reopen both clients and reconcile one durable receipt.
atomic.unresolved_gap: Need controllable actual service restart/await points plus two app instances. Local transaction tests cannot certify native draft/recovery UI; snapshot equality alone misses intermediate partial exposure.

authored.unresolved_gap: Frozen authored-validation imports validateItem directly. Needs real command-path rejection and native observation; UI cannot safely manufacture every invalid payload.

discussion.unresolved_gap: Controlled clock/await/eviction/protocol cases remain unimplemented at real app boundary; a successful send does not prove non-disclosure or exact replay order.

media.unresolved_gap: Browser peer tests use harness signaling and no ICE servers; model tests are not native transport. Need native bridge, authorization, cross-network/TURN and quota fault cases separately.

performance.unresolved_gap: Reference JS benchmark/local burst cannot establish native speed or WAN SLA. Need explicit authorized isolated measurement setup; no timing claims made.

def test_unsigned_tampered_truncated_and_wrong_key_feeds_stop_before_archive(self):

def test_signed_feed_warning_and_multibyte_content_use_byte_length(self):
        # Sparkle 2.10.1 common_cli/Signing.swift signs the XML after adding its warning.
        content = '<?xml version="1.0"?><!-- sparkle-sign-warning: Synthetic warning --><rss>Scriv café → B</rss>'.encode()
        feed = self.signed(content)

        bad = feed.replace(f'length: {len(content)}'.encode(), f'length: {len(content.decode())}'.encode())

tests.source_excerpt:
def test_symlinked_or_oversized_staged_control_file_is_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder = Path(tmp); self.fixture(folder)
            p = folder / 'manifest.json'; data = p.read_bytes();p.unlink()
            other = folder / 'other.json';other.write_bytes(data);p.symlink_to(other)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): self.verify(folder)
            p.unlink();p.write_bytes(b'x' * 8193)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError): self.verify(folder)

it('provides a hibernating socket and repairs a gap using sequence replay',async()=>{const a=await user(),team=await paidTeam(a),p=await seeded(a.token,team);const result=await app.fetch(`https://scriv.test/v1/projects/${p}/socket`,{headers:{authorization:`Bearer ${a.token}`,upgrade:'websocket'}});expect(result.status).toBe(101);const socket=result.webSocket!;sockets.push(socket);const hello=waitMessage(socket,v=>v.type==='hello');socket.accept();expect((await hello).deviceId).toBe(a.sid);const replay=waitMessage(socket,v=>v.type==='events');socket.send(JSON.stringify({type:'resume',after:0}));expect((await replay).events[0].seq).toBe(1);const watermark=waitMessage(socket,v=>v.type==='watermark');socket.send(JSON.stringify({type:'ping',after:0}));expect((await watermark).headSeq).toBe(1);});
